categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production and sales of AMOLED high-end touch panel sensors and thin-film transistor (TFT) driving backplanes. It also invests in related fields such as electronic paper display technology and hospitality services through subsidiaries. The main product lines include touch sensors for smartphones, wearables, tablets, and IT products, as well as TFT backplanes for electronic shelf labels and other display applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced AMOLED OCTA touch sensor technology with features like fine line width, narrow bezels, and high transmittance. It employs a highly automated production line with TFT-level equipment and has developed proprietary technologies such as HIAA (Hole in Active Area) for full-screen designs and soft flexible TFT element processes. The company also develops optical fingerprint recognition sensors and electronic paper TFT backplanes, integrating AI-assisted production scheduling and quality control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are international brand manufacturers, especially Korean panel makers, focusing on high-end smartphones, wearables, tablets, and IT devices. The company also serves markets for electronic shelf labels (ESL), industrial control, automotive displays, and emerging applications like medical sensors and 5G antennas. The electronic paper products target retail, logistics, education, and signage sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Tainan and offices in Neihu. Its customer base is global, with significant sales to Korean manufacturers and international brands. It also has subsidiaries and investments in mainland China and the Cayman Islands, supporting its diversified business operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the display and touch panel supply chain, manufacturing key components such as AMOLED touch sensors and TFT backplanes. It acts as a specialized supplier to panel manufacturers and device assemblers, providing design, development, and production services. It also extends into downstream applications through electronic paper products and hospitality investments.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AMOLED OCTA touch sensor technology, expanding electronic paper TFT backplane applications, and developing new product platforms such as optical fingerprint sensors and flexible TFT elements. The company emphasizes cost control, production efficiency, and high automation. It pursues cross-disciplinary R&D collaborations for emerging technologies like transparent projection films, physiological signal sensors, and 5G antennas, aiming to diversify applications and enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of touch sensors and TFT backplanes. The company provides design and manufacturing services to major panel and device manufacturers. It also earns income from investments in subsidiaries engaged in hospitality and retail services. The revenue mix includes sales to domestic and international customers, with a focus on long-term supply contracts and expanding product portfolios.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the top two global suppliers of rigid AMOLED touch sensors, holding a near 90% market share in smart wearable touch sensors. It competes with other panel and touch sensor manufacturers by leveraging high-precision automated production, advanced technology platforms, and cost advantages. Its electronic paper TFT backplane business faces competition from module and backplane manufacturers but maintains a strong position through technology upgrades and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported fiscal year, the company recorded net operating revenue of approximately NT$1.47 billion, representing a 10% increase from the prior year. However, it reported operating losses and net losses attributable to the parent company, reflecting challenges in profitability. The company maintains substantial assets and equity but faces pressure on retained earnings due to losses. R&D expenses account for about 1.7% of revenue, with plans to increase investment to around 3% to support growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, highly automated production lines capable of producing ultra-thin, narrow-bezel AMOLED touch sensors with superior reliability and cost competitiveness. Its proprietary technologies such as HIAA and advanced TFT processes enable differentiated products for high-end smartphones and emerging IT applications. The integration of flexible TFT backplanes and optical fingerprint sensors adds value by addressing new market needs. Commitment to sustainability, ESG principles, and customer-centric service further differentiate the company in the global supply chain.
